summary: Allegiant Travel Company (Allegiant) filed an 8-K (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) disclosing unaudited pro forma financials combining its results with Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc., reflecting its pending acquisition of Sun Country. The pro forma adjustments are preliminary and subject to change. Allegiant also disclosed recent aircraft financings totaling approximately $224.7 million in draws under secured credit facilities (SOFR-based, quarterly installments over 3–12 years). The filing does not specify per-share price, premium, or advisors. The deal appears to be cash/stock; close timeline and regulatory clearance status are not disclosed. Risk-arb investors should watch for regulatory approval milestones and further deal terms.
